extension.description: Watch free episodes and clips of PBS Kids shows. Browse shows A-Z, search, and keep a list of your favourite shows.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not affiliated with PBS. Content availability is decided by PBS Kids and may be limited to the United States.
extension.news: v4.0.0 - Rewritten for Kodi 19+ (Python 3), no external module dependency - Shows A-Z, episodes and clips with paging - Search with search history - Favourite shows (context menu) - Response caching and subtitle support
